mapper.select: SELECT use_yn,prj_stts_cd FROM prj.prj WHERE prj_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT phs_id,prj_id,phs_seq,phs_nm,wght_rt,plan_bgn_dt,plan_end_dt,cmpl_dt, CASE WHEN cmpl_dt IS NOT NULL THEN '완료' WHEN plan_bgn_dt IS NULL OR plan_end_dt IS NULL THEN '예정' WHEN plan_end_dt < #{today} THEN '지연' WHEN plan_bgn_dt <= #{today} AND plan_end_dt >= #{today} THEN '진행 중' ELSE '예정' END AS status FROM prj.phs WHERE prj_id=#{id} AND phs_id=#{phsId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE prj.phs SET cmpl_dt=#{key.today},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE prj_id=#{key.id} AND phs_id=#{key.phsId} AND cmpl_dt IS NULL
UPDATE prj.phs SET cmpl_dt=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE prj_id=#{key.id} AND phs_id=#{key.phsId} AND cmpl_dt IS NOT NULL
